units.source_text: 此次法会，原是为了经堂成立伊始，在家中私下举办的。

en.t: This Buddhist service had originally been intended as a private ceremony at home to mark the newly completed sutra hall.

units.source_text: 但皇上及山中的朱雀院闻讯，都派遣使者前来，

en.t: But when the Emperor and Suzaku-in in the mountains heard of it, they both sent messengers.

units.source_text: 致送诵经布施物品，非常丰隆，于是排场忽然扩大了。

en.t: They brought offerings for the sutra recitation in such abundance that the scale of the ceremony suddenly grew much larger.

units.source_text: 六条院所准备的设施，虽然源氏主张从简，也已经比寻常世间体面得多了，

en.t: The arrangements prepared at Rokujo-in, though Genji had insisted on keeping them simple, were already far more splendid than ordinary worldly standards.

units.source_text: 何况又加了皇上及朱雀院的隆仪。

en.t: All the more so once the generous honors from the Emperor and Suzaku-in were added.

units.source_text: 因此僧众傍晚散会时，布施品满载而归，寺内几乎容纳不下。

en.t: As a result, when the monks dispersed in the evening, they went back loaded with offerings, and the temple could hardly contain them all.
